source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026
note: The tracker's own work, tracked in the tracker — rule 26. Statuses here are what is actually true, not what was planned.

items.title: The tracker is a separate repository with its own history
items.description: VOID-za/eje-tracker, outside the EJE checkout entirely, so that the EJE lint, typecheck and build never see tracker files and the tracker can never become a dependency of the EJE application.
items.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026

items.title: The tracker database, its schema and its migrations
items.description: Its own database, its own role, plain numbered SQL migrations applied once and in order, one transaction per migration. Tables: items, history, relations, item_files, commits, releases, release_items, verification_runs, rules, decisions, users, sessions, audit_log.
items.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026

items.title: The Rules model
items.description: Rules are stored verbatim with the source of each one named against it. Rules 1-10, 25, 26, 27 and the development authentication rule were recovered and imported exactly. Rules 11-24 could not be found in any authoritative source available to the tracker and are recorded with empty text and the status SOURCE_MISSING. This item stays open until the project owner supplies that wording.
items.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026

items.title: The task model: two axes, and a lifecycle that cannot be skipped
items.description: status (how far the work has got) and delivery (how far the code has got) are separate columns with separate vocabularies, and a status change goes through the lifecycle — OPEN cannot jump to DONE.
items.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026

items.title: Decisions, with the question and the options kept after the answer
items.description: Every unresolved business decision in the scope is imported as an item of kind Decision plus a decision record. An unanswered question is DECISION_REQUIRED; an answered one keeps the original question and options beside the answer.
items.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026

items.title: Audit findings stay visible until they are resolved
items.description: Findings are imported with their severity and evidence. A finding the scope marks an ACCEPTANCE BLOCKER becomes an acceptance blocker in the tracker and is counted on the dashboard.
items.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026

items.title: Acceptance criteria
items.description: The offline and tablet acceptance criteria are imported as their own kind and are OPEN, because none of them is met.
items.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026

items.title: Verification records
items.description: Verification runs carry the command, the result, the counts and the commit they ran at. The gates the scope records at ca1cda7 are imported as evidence against the row that states them.
items.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026

items.title: Commit and release records
items.description: Commits are imported from the EJE checkout; a release is a commit plus where it actually is.
items.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026

items.title: Deployment evidence, never a deployment claim
items.description: Deployment is read from the live application's own /api/health build stamp and git ancestry, and the evidence string is stored with the release. There is no form anywhere in the tracker that lets somebody assert a deployment.
items.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026

items.title: The docs/SCOPE.md importer
items.description: Read-only against the EJE repository, repeatable and idempotent: the second import of the same document changes nothing and records nothing. An item that leaves the document is kept and marked, never deleted.
items.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026

items.title: The dashboard
items.description: Done, built-but-not-accepted, in progress, waiting on somebody, not deployed, what is running in production, acceptance blockers, open decisions, recent activity, and a breakdown by area and kind.
items.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026

items.title: The Rules page
items.description: Every rule, verbatim, with its source, its category, its dates and its history — and the missing ones shown as loudly as the present ones.
items.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026

items.title: Item list and item detail
items.description: The detail page carries where an item came from, what it relates to, which commits claim to implement it, which files those commits added and removed, what was verified, and every change ever made to it.
items.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026

items.title: Filtering and search
items.description: Filter by kind, status, delivery, priority and area; search across id, title, description and notes. Sorting is a whitelist and every filter is a parameterised query.
items.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026

items.title: Authenticated access
items.description: scrypt passwords, server-side sessions stored as hashes, CSRF on every mutating request, security headers on every response, audit logging of sign-ins and changes. One administrator account, created on the server; the password is never in Git, in code, in a document, in a seed or in a log.
items.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026

items.title: The machine-readable API
items.description: Read-only JSON at /api/summary, /api/items, /api/items/:id, /api/rules, /api/decisions, /api/releases and /api/verification, for ChatGPT, Claude or any other tool. A bearer token reads; it can never write.
items.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026

items.title: Tests
items.description: node:test covering the lifecycle, the progress arithmetic, password hashing, CSRF, HTML escaping, the scope parser, the rules gap, the database layer, import idempotency, the non-destructive import, and the HTTP gate end to end.
items.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026

items.title: VPS deployment and runbook material
items.description: systemd unit, environment template, database creation SQL, migrations, the runbook with exact commands, SSH tunnel instructions, a future Caddy fragment, verification commands, backup and rollback. Nothing has been executed: Claude has no shell access to the VPS.
items.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026

items.title: The EJE repository is untouched
items.description: Verified: the EJE working tree is clean at dda07f6 and no tracker file exists inside it.
items.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026

items.title: The tracker is deployed to the VPS
items.description: Not done, and not Claude's to do. A human runs docs/deployment.md. The first step is checking that 127.0.0.1:3100 is actually free with ss -ltnp; if it is occupied, stop and report it rather than choosing another port.
items.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026

items.title: The tablet layout is verified at tablet viewports
items.description: Checked in Chromium at 768x1024, 1024x768 and 390x844 across every page: no horizontal overflow anywhere, tables scroll inside their panel rather than dragging the page sideways, and controls are at least 44px high.
items.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026

items.title: demoSwitcher = true is deliberate, and is not a defect
items.description: https://eje.syncza.co.za is the demonstration, development and testing environment. The demo users and the role-switching mechanism are intentional and must not be removed, changed or replaced; production authentication is a later, separate phase. Recorded here so that a later reader does not mistake it for an accidental production configuration.
items.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026

items.title: Automation of tracker updates
items.description: Designed for, deliberately not built: git hooks or a timer could run the importers, and deployment health could update deployment status. No automation may modify EJE production behaviour, deploy anything, or mutate the EJE database.
items.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026

decisions.title: What is the authoritative wording of project rules 11-24?
decisions.description: The project owner's instruction states that rules 11-24 already exist in the established EJE project rules and must be recovered from the authoritative project context or source rather than guessed, rewritten or invented. They are not in the EJE repository, not in docs/SCOPE.md, and not in any source available to the tracker. Fourteen rules are therefore recorded with empty text and the status SOURCE_MISSING, and counted on the dashboard, until the wording is supplied.
decisions.source: EJE project owner instruction — "EJE PROJECT CONTROL SYSTEM — PHASE 2: RULES + LIVE PROJECT TRACKER", 25 September 2026
decisions.question: What is the authoritative wording of EJE project rules 11-24?
decisions.options:
(a) Supply the wording from the authoritative project source, and re-import.
(b) Confirm that no such rules exist, and renumber the series deliberately.
(c) Write them afresh as a new, dated set of rules — which would be new rules, not a recovery.
